_comment: gb perf fails when a measured value exceeds its budget. frame_ms and draw_calls are only checked in a window run. Spec: the battle scene (tests/fixtures/perf_battle.tscn, 40 against 40 plus workers, fog on, vsync off, --seconds 120). Physics is Godot's worst physics frame of each second: an RTS battle of ~86 GDScript units measured 8.9 ms at worst (4.2 ms on average of those worst frames, script cost p95 2.1 ms a frame headless), so the budget is 10 ms, which still fits a 60 fps frame.
